overview_description.description: Arabian Plastic Industrial Company is a manufacturer within the packaging sector. The organization specializes in injection molding, film extrusion, blow molding, and thermoforming production services. It manufactures disposable products, heavy-duty shopping bags, loop handle bags, wicketed bags, and grip hole containers. The business produces custom molded crates, battery accessories, and specialized plastic components based on client blueprints.
